regions.name: National
regions.where: All of Haiti (no regional titles or locator map)

harvest.name: Winter harvest (off-season; outside the shaded rainy seasons)

planting.name: Winter planting (off-season; outside the shaded rainy seasons)

regions.notes: First Rainy Season Mar 1 to mid-Jun; Second Rainy Season Aug 1 to mid-Nov. Lean box mid-Feb to mid-Jun. Winter harvest: unlabelled bar from mid-Dec plus the 'Winter' bar Jan to mid-Mar (one season, wrapping). Main: Spring harvest Jun-Jul; Fall harvest Oct to mid-Nov. Green-harvest (teal) row excluded.

assign.method: Single national calendar with no regional titles or locator map; every adm1 mapped to national.

transcriber_notes: Edges drawn at mid-month are counted (at-least-half rule); the lean box (mid-Feb, mid-Jun), the end of the First Rainy Season (mid-Jun), the end of the Second Rainy Season (mid-Nov), and the Winter and Fall harvest edges are at mid-month. The image does not say whether the Winter season is irrigated.
